product.name: Turntable Data IDE
product.description: A collaborative code editor for running queries, documenting tables, and transforming data using dbt Core, SQLMesh, or SQL.

product.name: Automated Data Catalog
product.description: A system that syncs data sources, metrics, and dashboards with up-to-date metadata and documentation.

product.name: Virtual Data Branches
product.description: A feature that allows users to modify, preview, and deploy data transformations and BI changes instantly without duplicating data.

product.name: Data Stack Monitoring and Orchestration
product.description: A system providing end-to-end visibility, alerting, and monitoring of data pipelines and dashboards to detect breaking changes and data quality issues.
